d:
What happens when your dreams come true the very next day? Well, Sunny's family is about to find out!
FilterCopy presents “Dream Family Episode 2 – Behen Phas Gayi” – another day of madness in the life of a cute, chaotic, middle-class Indian family where Sunny, the youngest child, has a rather unusual superpower: whatever he dreams about becomes reality the next morning!
This time, Sunny dreams that his sister gets stuck inside a room. And guess what? His dream actually comes true!
